Subject: Security preflight & evidence request — SOC 2 Type II + trust portal access (Sandstone Health)

Hi Liam / Ava — thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and next steps from our side so we can move the procurement path forward: 

• Ask: Sandstone has requested Redwood's latest SOC 2 Type II report or temporary bridge letter + access to our trust portal so your security team can pull artifacts.
• Scope clarification: you mentioned production data for API usage and a requirement for HIPAA/BAA questions — please confirm whether PHI will be sent to the API.
• Deliverables Redwood will provide (pending approvals): SOC 2 Type II report (when available) or an interim bridge letter, and invite to our Trust portal with read-only access to artifacts (attestations, policy excerpts, controls matrix).

Action items we need from Sandstone to move this fast: 
1) Confirm the scope (are you evaluating only hosted Redwood API or dedicated/private deployment as well?)
2) Share the primary security contact (+ any additional reviewers) for Portal invite (we can provision group access)
3) Complete the attached vendor DDQ (one sheet) so our security team can map any gaps.

I copied Neha (security) and Jordan (AE) — they will coordinate the handoff. If we get the DDQ back and confirmation on scope today, Neha can issue a bridge-letter timeline and we can send the portal invite within 48 hours.

Thanks — Hannah

Subject: RE: Security preflight & evidence request — SOC 2 Type II + trust portal access (Sandstone Health)

Thanks — saw the DDQ Liam sent. A few internal notes for the thread so we stay consistent with what we provide: 

• Bridge letter: we can produce an interim bridge letter that states the prior Type II report period (for example: Jan 1 2027 — Dec 31 2027) and confirms there are no known control exceptions since that report. The letter will note it covers Redwood's hosted inference API endpoints (api.redwood.ai) and the control domains tested.
• Trust portal: we will provision read-only access scoped to Sandstone's reviewers for 30 days by default; longer access is possible via request. We will not share raw logs by default — instead we surface the attestation artifacts, control narratives, and the auditor report. Specific artifact requests (e.g., penetration test report) may require an NDA or additional approval.
• HIPAA: our standard BAA language is handled by Legal; for procurement purposes we can provide alignment notes and controls mapping to HIPAA. If they will send PHI later, they must sign the BAA before any production pilot.

Jordan / Hannah — please ask them which exact people should be provisioned so we can create accounts and send invites. I'll draft the bridge letter template and the SOC2 scope guidance PDF and attach once ready.

—Neha Kapoor
Director, Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
